shared_elements: schematic anthropomorphic/figural motif with outstretched limbs (arms) in the centre
justification: A shows a radially symmetric toothed disc with concentric rings and openwork, enclosing a small central schematic mask/insect-like face; B shows a horizontal row of large stick-like human figures with outstretched arms, apparently holding a long staff or beam, above smaller animal figures. The only shared content is a very generic schematic anthropomorphic element with splayed limbs and bilateral symmetry, while the organising scheme (radial, concentric, enclosed vs. linear frieze of interacting figures) is entirely different.
